summary: CKGSB's global marketing team is prioritizing China-based programs—Asia Star and Intelligent China—while resolving urgent operational issues and advancing key content projects.
summaryDetail: The team is doubling down on China-based programs, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as the top marketing priorities, while US partnerships are on hold for the first quarter. This week, urgent attention is needed on the Outlook account lockout affecting multiple devices, and on finalizing feedback for the knowledge website redesign, which incorporates Joseph's editorial-style layout and brings BCI/BSI indices to the homepage. Content deliverables are also pressing: the work report content (Sep 14–Oct 30) is due by COB tomorrow, and Julie must send details on two news releases to Joseph. Additionally, the Custom Program page rewrite requires answers from Mara, Madi, and Xiao Rong, and the WIL Forum agenda and invitation letters need review. Upcoming, the team will continue to develop the marketing plan with a focus on conversion tracking and participant profile analysis, and may consider the Berkeley program as a third priority.
